<header class="page-hero compact-page-hero about-hero">
  <p class="eyebrow">About</p>
  <h1>From mathematical research to applied modelling and decision tools.</h1>
  <p>I am an applied mathematician and statistician with a career spanning research, university teaching and programme leadership. I now bring that background to industry-facing work in data science, optimisation, operational research and scientific computing.</p>
</header>

<section class="about-opening">
  <div class="about-opening-lead">
    <p>I have spent my career learning how to take difficult, ambiguous problems and make them precise: identify the right assumptions, build a defensible model, implement it computationally, test what it can and cannot say, and explain the result clearly.</p>
    <p>My academic work ranges from optimisation algorithms and dynamic MRI reconstruction to statistical models for Formula 1 and curling. Alongside research, I have led degree programmes, designed data-science teaching, supervised projects and built technical resources for varied audiences.</p>
  </div>
  <dl class="about-facts" aria-label="Career at a glance">
    <div><dt>11</dt><dd>peer-reviewed journal articles</dd></div>
    <div><dt>21</dt><dd>university modules taught</dd></div>
    <div><dt>9</dt><dd>research students supervised</dd></div>
    <div><dt>3</dt><dd>countries in my academic career</dd></div>
  </dl>
</section>

<section class="about-career" aria-labelledby="career-title">
  <div class="about-section-heading">
    <p class="eyebrow">Academic career</p>
    <h2 id="career-title">Research, teaching and leadership across three universities</h2>
  </div>
  <div class="career-timeline">
    <article class="career-stage">
      <div class="career-period">2014–2018</div>
      <div class="career-copy">
        <p class="career-place">University of Sussex · UK</p>
        <h3>EPSRC-funded PhD in Mathematics</h3>
        <p>Studied variational models, PDEs and material microstructures, graduating with a viva outcome of pass with no corrections. I also worked as an Associate Tutor across analysis, geometry, probability and statistics.</p>
      </div>
    </article>
    <article class="career-stage">
      <div class="career-period">2018–2021</div>
      <div class="career-copy">
        <p class="career-place">University of Graz · Austria</p>
        <h3>Postdoctoral Researcher</h3>
        <p>Worked on an Austrian Science Fund project in motion-aware medical imaging, developing mathematical frameworks and optimisation algorithms for dynamic inverse problems under severe noise and undersampling.</p>
      </div>
    </article>
    <article class="career-stage">
      <div class="career-period">2022–2023</div>
      <div class="career-copy">
        <p class="career-place">University of Graz · Austria</p>
        <h3>Faculty member · University Assistant</h3>
        <p>Contributed to the Inverse Problems and Mathematical Imaging group through research, undergraduate and postgraduate teaching, supervision and grant-development activity.</p>
      </div>
    </article>
    <article class="career-stage">
      <div class="career-period">2023–2026</div>
      <div class="career-copy">
        <p class="career-place">University of Hull · UK</p>
        <h3>Permanent Lecturer in Applied Mathematics</h3>
        <p>This is the UK academic grade closest to Assistant Professor. I combined research with module leadership, PhD and dissertation supervision, and later served as Programme Director for the MSc in Mathematics.</p>
      </div>
    </article>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="about-transition">
  <div>
    <p class="eyebrow">What comes next</p>
    <h2>Carrying the strongest parts of academia into industry</h2>
  </div>
  <div>
    <p>In 2026 I chose to leave my permanent academic post and transition toward industry. That career remains the foundation of how I work: rigorous problem formulation, evidence-based reasoning, long-horizon project ownership and the ability to communicate technical ideas to different audiences.</p>
    <p>I am particularly interested in roles where mathematical modelling, statistics and computation support prediction, operational decisions or scientific discovery.</p>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="about-capabilities" aria-label="How I work">
  <article>
    <span>01</span>
    <h3>Frame the problem</h3>
    <p>Turn an open-ended question into assumptions, objectives, constraints and measurable outcomes.</p>
  </article>
  <article>
    <span>02</span>
    <h3>Build and test</h3>
    <p>Move from mathematical formulation to reproducible code, numerical experiments and model evaluation.</p>
  </article>
  <article>
    <span>03</span>
    <h3>Explain clearly</h3>
    <p>Produce technical writing, presentations, documentation and teaching materials that preserve substance without unnecessary complexity.</p>
  </article>
  <article>
    <span>04</span>
    <h3>Lead collaboratively</h3>
    <p>Coordinate programmes and projects, mentor researchers, build collaborations and connect people with different expertise.</p>
  </article>
</section>
